February, 2026
 SLP(Cr
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. Of 2026
 (arising out of SLP(Crl.) No. 11372 of 2019)
 Nalini Sharma ..... Appella
 Versus
 Deputy Commissioner Of Police ..... Respond
 Crime Branch New Delhi & Anr.
 O R D E R
Leave granted.

The appellant, Nalini Sharma, is before this Court aggrieved by the final judgment and order dated 08.11.2019 passed by the High Court of Delhi in W.P. (Crl.) No. 1330/2009 filed by her, whereby the High Court refused to quash the criminal proceedings against her in First Information Report (FIR)
No. 247/1988 dated 22.11.1988 registered with Police Station  Kotla Mubarakpur, New Delhi, for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468, 471 and 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
We are informed that in relation to several other accused named in the aforestated FIR, the proceedings were quashed by the High Court of Delhi.

entities.text: Police Station  Kotla Mubarakpur, New Delhi
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
One such order relating to Veena Sawhney,
an accused in the said FIR, is placed on record.

The said order dated 20.03.2009 was passed in Criminal M.C. No. 3126/2006 and Criminal Date:
2026.02.05 17:58:20 IST Reason:
M.A. No. 5127/2006.
By the said order, the prayer of the petitioner therein to quash the aforestated FIR, insofar as she was concerned, was accepted and she stood discharged in relation thereto.
We find no grounds to deny the same relief to the appellant, Nalini Sharma, who is identically situated.
